note: API entry now calls check_only; consume_summary_quota moved into the workflow launcher after a new run starts, skipping the already-started and cached paths.
Renames the exported helper to stringifyWithBigInts and documents that only bigints are handled; call sites updated.
Adds a shared trace_id_resolver module in hogql_queries/ai and uses it to scope single-generation lookups by trace id; no dedicated query runner.
Adds buildMCPContextProperties helper with optional prefix and uses it for both context and previous-context properties instead of inline snake_case copies.
Moves the Team signal receivers out of the tasks module into a storage signal-handlers module registered from apps.py ready().
Renames a signal-wait method and removes an unused timestamp field; no CI message extraction or guidance changes.
Caps the discovery loop by config.max_pages and reworks ingest logic; crawl remains synchronous, no async or worker offload.
Extracts a hasConditions constant and uses it for both the conditions column gate and the properties column span.
Drops the useState remount key; onCreated now calls hogFunctionsListLogic.loadHogFunctions to refresh the list.
Replaces the duplicate pre-team and team chain interfaces and factories with a generic Chain plus pendingChain/committedChain and type aliases.
Removes the separate version-fetching loop step; each publish step now captures its version output, and the summary uses those outputs.
Switches the audit log call to is_impersonated from posthog.helpers.impersonation and scopes the dedup check by team.
Removes summary, hypotheses, recommendations and tool call count from the signal extra metadata; drops verdict weights.
Deletes the custom HeatmapTooltip component and reuses DefaultTooltip for the single hovered cell in Heatmap.tsx.
Adds emit_short_circuit on the canonical log line and both short-circuit branches call it instead of the four emitters.
Moves used properties, sorted properties and winning-condition flags into kea selectors; card color ternary and error-banner copy remain in the component.
Splits run_evaluation.py into llm judge, hog, sentiment, event io, types and workflow activity modules, leaving the workflow router.
Adds an internal flag to a draft call and changes a confidence comparison; LLM client stack unchanged.
Resolves dependency ids from flag filters by id or key instead of DB queries; no shared error message constant.
Renames the ClassifiedMessage interface to SessionEntry throughout the file.
